python.name: Python
python.description: CPython interpreter with pip, from the python-build-standalone project (relocatable install_only builds).

php.name: PHP CLI
php.description: Static PHP command-line interpreter built in CI from php.net sources with static-php-cli (musl, no host libraries needed).

go.name: Go
go.description: The Go toolchain (go, gofmt) from the official go.dev Linux archives.

nodejs.name: Node.js
nodejs.description: Node.js JavaScript runtime with its bundled npm and npx, from the official nodejs.org Linux archives (LTS lines).

rust.name: Rust
rust.description: The Rust toolchain (rustc, cargo, rust-std, rustfmt, clippy) from the official static.rust-lang.org dist components, installed as one standalone prefix (not rustup).

java.name: Eclipse Temurin JDK
java.description: Eclipse Temurin JDK (HotSpot) LTS and current feature releases from the Adoptium API: java, javac, jar and jshell, with JAVA_HOME pointing at the version prefix.

bun.name: Bun
bun.description: Bun JavaScript/TypeScript runtime, bundler and package manager from the official oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, verified against SHASUMS256.txt and the GitHub asset digest.

deno.name: Deno
deno.description: Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime from the official denoland/deno GitHub releases, verified against the release .sha256sum files, GitHub asset digests and build-provenance attestations.

dotnet.name: .NET SDK (C#/.NET)
dotnet.description: Microsoft .NET SDK with the included .NET and ASP.NET Core runtimes, providing the C# (and F#/VB) toolchain, from the official Microsoft release metadata (active LTS and STS channels), with hashes taken from that metadata.

clang.name: Clang/LLVM
clang.description: Clang C/C++ compilers with the LLVM toolchain (clang, clang++, ld.lld, lldb, libc++ libraries and headers) from the official LLVM Linux release binaries, verified against the GitHub asset digest and the release's SLSA build-provenance attestation bundle.

flutter.name: Flutter
flutter.description: Flutter SDK (with its bundled Dart SDK: flutter and dart) from the official Google Flutter Linux release archives, verified against the SHA-256 in Google's releases_linux.json. Google publishes x86_64 Linux host archives only.

composer.name: Composer
composer.description: Composer PHP dependency manager: the verified composer.phar (GitHub asset digest cross-checked against getcomposer.org's SHA-256) plus a generated bin/composer wrapper that runs it with the PHP CLI on PATH.

zig.name: Zig
zig.description: Zig compiler and build tool from the official ziglang.org Linux archives, verified against the SHA-256 and size in the official download index.

kotlin.name: Kotlin
kotlin.description: Kotlin command-line compiler (kotlinc and kotlin) from the official JetBrains/kotlin releases, verified against the GitHub asset digest and the published .zip.sha256; needs a JDK on PATH.

cmake.name: CMake
cmake.description: CMake, CTest and CPack from the official Kitware Linux release archives, verified against the GitHub asset digest and the release's SHA-256.txt.

gradle.name: Gradle
gradle.description: Gradle build tool from the official services.gradle.org distribution, verified against Gradle's published .sha256; needs a JDK on PATH.

maven.name: Apache Maven
maven.description: Apache Maven build tool from the official Apache archive, verified against Apache's published .sha512; needs a JDK on PATH.
